name: ettin
card: Goal: Pareto-best Ettin in-browser query embedder (cold start vs hit@10). Dir experiments/ettin-native. Bluesky task (61,686 posts, 1,498 synth_test, hit@10, own remex 2-bit codes): off-the-shelf Ettin best capemox/ettin-encoder-17m-pretrain-50m 0.777; leaf-ir 0.893 (fp32 torch, 22.9M); EG2 q4 0.918. Weight-only int8 MatMul lossless (cos 0.9994), ORT dynamic int8 bad (0.926 med). Ettin-17m = 3.9M transformer + 12.9M table. Next: LEAF-style distill Ettin-17m/32m from snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v1.5, then compress ladder + browser bench.

name: mteb
card: sub-100M MTEB ranking sent to ettin,wasm (card-derived, 33-task English core). Top <25M: GIST-all-MiniLM-L6-v2 62.4. Next: verify official averages

name: wasm
card: Goal: runtime-free leaf-ir in the browser (own WordPiece + JS forward + one WASM SIMD matmul kernel, no onnxruntime-web). Dir experiments/leaf-wasm. Tokenizer 0 mismatches vs HF on 64,244 texts; JS f32 vs ORT fp32 min cos 0.99999993 (460 fixtures); own int8 weights (per-column matmul, per-row table, dequant to f32 at load) 23.76 MB, min cos 0.99897. Kernel 394 B. Latency pending (CPU contended). Next: hit@10 of int8 via patched ONNX, then uncontended latency + browser page.

name: mteb
